{{Quote|I think you've forgotten something.''"<br />"''Some things, you mean. Walk worms.|A Human and Gotal guard, observing Mace Windu's trek towards the fortress|<ref name="Survivors" />}}
'''Walk worms''' were a giant [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Worm/Legends|worm]]. They had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[exoskeleton]]s with tan undersides, multiple sets of [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and large mandibles. At least eleven walk worms inhabited the burrows below a narrow cliff path to the [[Uda-Khalid's headquarters|fortress]] of the mass [[Death/Legends|murderer]] [[Uda-Khalid]] on a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Unidentified jungle world (Uda-Khalid)|terrestrial body]].<ref name="Survivors" /> 

Between approximately [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]] and [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Survivors (comic story)|Survivors]]" takes place after the construction of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], established by "[[Stones]]" to have occurred at least 14 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after his birth, which [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates to [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]], 14 years before [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]]. Additionally, Windu states that he is a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in "Survivors," and {{StarshipsVehiclesCite|25|Welcome On Board}} states that he had achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the age of 28, corresponding to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. Therefore, Windu's [[Mission to Uda-Khalid's headquarters|mission]] depicted in "Survivors" must have taken place in between those [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] traveled across the narrow path on his [[Mission to Uda-Khalid's headquarters|mission]] to bring Uda-Khalid to justice. Two of Khalid's guards, a [[Unidentified Gotal (Uda-Khalid)|Gotal]] and a [[Unidentified Human guard (Uda-Khalid)|Human]], observed Windu from the fortress as he approached the path; they discussed their assumption that the walk worms would deal with the intruder before he became the guards' responsibility. As the walk worms emerged to attack Windu, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force jump/Legends|leap]] into the air and land safely on a further part of the path. As Windu continued walking, the segment of the path containing the walk worms burrows collapsed, sending the creatures tumbling down.<ref name="Survivors" />

==Behind the scenes==
Walk worms appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] "[[Survivors (comic story)|Survivors]]", which was written by [[Jim Krueger]] and illustrated by [[Kagan McLeod]]. The comic story appeared in the Mace Windu-centered [[Star Wars Tales 13|thirteenth issue]] of the anthology series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'',<ref name="Survivors" /> published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[September 25]], [[2002]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/11-898/Star-Wars-Tales-13|text=Star Wars Tales #13}}</ref>
